From: Program Director | Date: 2026-11-18 07:30
Host a 4-hour buildathon for 96 students, teams of 3, and 8 staff. Budget ceiling PKR 420000. The event runs 09:00-13:00. Include a mandatory 20-minute networking activity between 10:30 and 11:30. A generator is mandatory, not optional.

From: Venue Manager | Date: 2026-11-18 07:40
River Hall: 120 seats, PKR 62000, no generator. Summit Hall: 130 seats, PKR 88000, generator included. Harbor Hall: 180 seats, PKR 115000, generator included. All available 09:00-13:00.

From: Catering Vendor | Date: 2026-11-18 07:50
Standard meal is PKR 1050 per person. Basic meal is PKR 720 per person. Standard is preferred but basic is allowed if necessary to remain within budget. Delivery fee PKR 4000 is mandatory for either tier.

From: Judging Coordinator | Date: 2026-11-18 08:00
12 judges are available, but only engaged judges attend and receive honoraria of PKR 4500 each. Maximum 4 teams per judge, 12 minutes per team. Judging window is 12:00-13:00 with parallel judging allowed.

From: Finance Officer | Date: 2026-11-18 08:05
Committed prizes PKR 70000, equipment rental PKR 12000, and printing PKR 6000 must all count toward the budget.

From: Student Council | Date: 2026-11-18 08:10
Can we add a photo booth for PKR 25000? Just an idea; no approval yet.

From: Catering Vendor | Date: 2026-11-18 08:15
Assalam o alaikum, khana sab attending logon ke liye hoga. Delivery ki fee wohi PKR 4000 hai.
